data.title: 五河琴里 · 晨曦软被中的红发甜梦
data.description: 清晨明朗的阳光洒在小巧可爱的床榻上。琴里抱着大号的白熊玩偶侧蜷在松软的薄被里，一件略大号的连帽衫从一侧肩头滑落，露出光滑洁白的小香肩。红色的长马尾凌乱地散在枕头四处，少女嘴里叼着一根珍宝珠棒棒糖的细棍，睡眼惺忪地微微睁开一只眼睛，露出甜软无比的晨起撒娇神情。
data.location: bright morning bedroom filled with sunshine
data.action: curled up in bed hugging plush teddy bear, oversized hoodie slipping off shoulder, messy red hair on pillow, lollipop stick in mouth, sleepy one-eye wink with cute blush
data.lighting: bright morning sunlight spilling cheerfully across colorful bedroom
data.mood: adorable domestic sweetness, playful morning affection
data.promptProse: Curled up in a sunlit bed hugging a giant white teddy bear, Kotori wears an oversized hoodie slipping off one shoulder. Her red twintails are adorably tousled as she looks up with a sweet, sleepy morning smile.
data.animaCaption: Kotori hugging a plush toy on a sunlit bed in an oversized hoodie, smiling sleepily.
